work.title: Untitled (Gallery Diptych View)
work.description: Gallery installation view showing two framed collages hung side by side on a grey wall. Left work features sparse composition with American football and chess piece on architectural-drawing ground; right work presents dense, colorful collage with footballs, targets, compact discs, and grid elements.
work.composition: two framed works side by side
